summary: The French answers are mostly correct, but as in the other courses this file is the English grammar course: English fill-in prompts, English grammar hints, and whole sentences as cloze answers. Each item has been rewritten as French grammar practice. Actual French errors: 'Si il' (should be 'S'il'), 'Elle se réveille tôt' for 'she is used to waking early', a missing reflexive, 'projet' for draft, and an emphasis question that mistranslates 'front a phrase'.

findings.problem: English fill-in prompt with an English hint.

fix.text: Say: She is a teacher.

list: No article before professions after 'être'.
Elle est professeure.
Elle est prof.

findings.problem: The only hint is generic.

list: 'Ce sont' is used before a plural noun phrase.
Ce sont mes amies.
Ils sont mes amis.

findings.problem: English fill-in with a hint about 'do not'.

fix.text: Say: I don't like coffee.

list: 'Ne ... pas' wraps the verb; 'ne' becomes 'n'' before a vowel.

findings.problem: English fill-in; also, French drops the article in 'nous sommes étudiants'.

fix.text: Say: We are students.
Nous sommes étudiants.

list: Nous sommes étudiantes.
On est étudiants.
No article before a role after 'être'.

findings.problem: The cloze is English and the answer a whole sentence.

fix.text: Il ___ l'anglais tous les jours. (étudier)
étudie

list: -er verbs end in -e in the 'il' form.

findings.problem: The hint describes English 'there is/are'; French 'il y a' covers both.

list: 'Il y a' = there is / there are — one form for both.

findings.problem: English fill-in about do-support.

fix.text: Ask: Do you like tea?

list: French has no auxiliary 'do': use intonation, 'est-ce que' or inversion.
Est-ce que tu aimes le thé ?
Aimes-tu le thé ?
Vous aimez le thé ?

findings.problem: The cloze tests English a/an and the answer is a whole sentence.

fix.text: Elle a ___ parapluie.
un

list: 'Parapluie' is masculine.

findings.problem: The hint describes English; a female speaker says 'fatiguée'.

list: 'Ne ... pas' around the verb. Feminine: fatiguée.

findings.problem: English fill-in about the present continuous.

fix.text: Say: The cats are sleeping.

list: French has no continuous tense: 'ils dorment' covers both.

findings.problem: The hint is about English -s.

list: 'Aller' is irregular: elle va.

findings.problem: The hint is about English 'are'; feminine and 'contents' should be accepted.

list: 'Heureux' is the same in the masculine plural; feminine: heureuses.
Elles sont heureuses.
Ils sont contents.

findings.problem: The hint is about English; the feminine form is missing.

list: 'Aller' takes 'être' in the passé composé.
Je suis allée au supermarché hier.
Hier, je suis allé au supermarché.

findings.problem: English fill-in about has/have.

fix.text: Say: She has been waiting for an hour.

list: Present tense + 'depuis' for something still going on.

findings.problem: 'Si il' must elide to 'S'il'; the hint describes English.

fix.text: S'il pleut, nous resterons à l'intérieur.

list: 'Si' + present, then the future. 'Si' becomes 's'' before 'il'.

findings.problem: The cloze is English and the answer a whole sentence.

fix.text: Samedi dernier, je ___ au cinéma.
suis allé

list: suis allée
Passé composé of 'aller' with 'être'.

findings.problem: English fill-in about was/were.

fix.text: Say: He was working at seven this morning.

list: The imparfait describes an action in progress in the past.
Il était en train de travailler à sept heures ce matin.

findings.problem: The hint describes the English present perfect.

list: Present tense + 'depuis' for duration up to now.
Nous habitons ici depuis cinq ans.
Ça fait cinq ans qu'on habite ici.

findings.problem: The cloze is English and the answer a whole sentence.

fix.text: Ce livre est ___ intéressant que l'autre.
plus

list: 'Plus ... que' = more ... than.

findings.problem: English fill-in about have/has.

fix.text: Ask: Have you been to Paris?

list: 'Déjà' = ever. French uses 'être allé' or 'avoir été'.
Vous êtes déjà allé à Paris ?
Tu es déjà allé à Paris ?
Avez-vous déjà été à Paris ?

findings.problem: English fill-in with an English hint.

fix.text: Say: You should drink more water.

list: Conditional of 'devoir' + infinitive for advice.
Vous devriez boire plus d'eau.

findings.problem: Asks about English much/many and has no blank; the answer is mistranslated.

fix.text: J'ai ___ amis à Paris. (many)
beaucoup d'

list: 'Beaucoup de' never changes; 'de' elides before a vowel.

findings.problem: The hint describes the English second conditional.

list: 'Si' + imparfait, then the conditional.

findings.problem: English fill-in about 'will have'.

fix.text: Say: By the time she arrives, we will have finished dinner.

list: French uses the future after 'quand'; future perfect in the main clause.

findings.problem: The hint is about English -ing.

list: 'Malgré' + noun: malgré sa fatigue.

findings.problem: The cloze is English and the answer a whole sentence.

fix.text: Le rapport a ___ rédigé par l'équipe la semaine dernière.
été

list: Passive: être + participle, here in the passé composé.

findings.problem: The hint describes English tense shift.

list: Plus-que-parfait 'avait envoyé' in reported speech.

findings.problem: English fill-in about had/have.

fix.text: Say: I wish I had more time to practice.

list: 'J'aimerais' + infinitive, or 'si seulement j'avais...'.
Si seulement j'avais plus de temps pour m'entraîner !

findings.problem: The hint is about English inversion.

list: 'Non seulement ..., mais ... aussi'; no inversion needed.

findings.problem: English fill-in; 'Elle se réveille tôt' drops 'is used to'.

fix.text: Say: She is used to waking up early.
Elle a l'habitude de se réveiller tôt.

list: 'Avoir l'habitude de' + infinitive.

findings.problem: The cloze tests English who/which and the answer is a whole sentence.

fix.text: La personne ___ a appelé n'a laissé aucun message.
qui

list: 'Qui' is the subject relative pronoun.

findings.problem: A cloze_sentence item with no blank cannot be answered.

fix.text: Quand dois-je utiliser la voix ___ ?
passive

list: The opposite of the active voice.

findings.problem: The hint describes English inversion.

list: 'Si' + plus-que-parfait, then conditionnel passé.

findings.problem: English fill-in about inversion.

fix.text: Say: Rarely have I seen such attention to detail.

list: 'Rarement' goes between the auxiliary and the participle.
J'ai rarement vu un tel souci du détail.

findings.problem: English fill-in about 'no sooner'.

fix.text: Say: No sooner had she arrived than the meeting began.

list: À peine était-elle arrivée que la réunion a commencé.
'Dès que' = as soon as; literary: 'À peine ... que'.

findings.problem: The hint describes English; the French subjunctive version should be accepted.

list: 'Il est grand temps de' + infinitive, or 'que' + subjunctive.
Il est grand temps que nous abordions les problèmes structurels de fond.

findings.problem: The cloze is English and the answer a whole sentence.

fix.text: Les données doivent être ___ avant de tirer des conclusions.
analysées

list: The participle agrees with 'les données' (feminine plural).

findings.problem: 'une candidate forte' is a calque; the hint describes English.

fix.text: Si elle postulait, elle serait une excellente candidate pour le poste.

list: 'Si' + imparfait, then the conditional.

findings.problem: English fill-in; 'devenir fluide' is not idiomatic for speaking fluently.

fix.text: Say: The more you practice, the more fluently you speak.
Plus vous pratiquez, plus vous parlez couramment.

list: Plus tu pratiques, plus tu parles couramment.
'Plus ..., plus ...' with no article.

findings.problem: 'préparer' needs the reflexive here: 'je me serais préparé'.

fix.text: Si je l'avais su plus tôt, je me serais préparé autrement.

list: Si je l'avais su plus tôt, je me serais préparée autrement.

findings.problem: A cloze_sentence with no blank; 'projet' doesn't mean draft.

fix.text: Non seulement elle a terminé à l'heure, ___ elle a aussi amélioré le brouillon.
mais

list: 'Non seulement ..., ___ ... aussi'.

findings.problem: 'quand on fait une phrase' doesn't mean fronting a phrase; the dialogue_turn also lacks a situation.

fix.text: Choose the best response. Your teacher moves a phrase to the start of your sentence and asks if you notice a difference.
Oui. Comment l'accent change-t-il quand on place un groupe de mots en tête de phrase ?
